primary_observations: Authority-aware ordering improved the declared-row search objective at horizon 16 and horizon 32.
Extending the search horizon from 16 to 32 improved the declared-row search objective under both residual and authority ordering.
Authority plus horizon 32 was the strongest tested primary arm by exact declared-row count and mean declared-row score.

Authority-selected nonzero coordinates were commonly deeper in the residual ordering; the authority h16 audit had mean residual-rank minus authority-rank migration of 10.28, with 94 used coordinates originally beyond residual rank 16.
All 220 reported candidates passed the inherited final geometry checks and independent audit agreement.
primary_nonclaims: This does not establish that 32 coordinates are required.
This does not establish that authority ordering is globally optimal.
This does not establish whole-endpoint isofunctionality; whole-endpoint scores remain diagnostic for group-local construction.
This does not establish a biological mechanism or a behavioral learning effect.
next_gate: Construct and audit whole-endpoint alternatives before any behavioral experiment.
